title: Default Parameters Check
description: Defaults for omitted/undefined args; falsy values are not replaced.

questions.explanation: Omitted `greeting` uses `"Hello"`. Passing `"Hi"` overrides the default.
Explicit `undefined` triggers the default for `height` (1). Result: `3 * 1 * 4 = 12`.
An empty string was passed on purpose. Defaults only apply for omitted/`undefined`, not for `""`.
`clamp(-5)` uses min 0 / max 100 → 0. Second call defaults min to 0 and caps max at 10 → 5 stays.

questions.prompt: When does a default parameter apply?

options.text: When the argument is omitted or explicitly `undefined`
On every call, overriding any passed value

questions.explanation: Defaults trigger for missing or `undefined` args. Falsy values that were passed deliberately are kept.
